verses.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਤਿਸ ਦੈ ਚਉ ਖੰਨੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: hau tis dhai chau kha(n)neeaai gur paramesar eko jaanai|

en.bdb: I am ready to be cut into four pieces for him who accepts Guru and God as one.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਤਿਸ ਦੈ ਚਉ ਖੰਨੀਐ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਨ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਆਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: hau tis dhai chau kha(n)neeaai dhoojaa bhaau na a(n)dhar aanai|

en.bdb: I am ready to be cut into four pieces for him who does not allow the sense of duality to enter in him.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਤਿਸ ਦੈ ਚਉ ਖੰਨੀਐ ਅਉਗੁਣੁ ਕੀਤੇ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਵਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: hau tis dhai chau kha(n)neeaai aaugun keete gun paravaanai|

en.bdb: I am ready to be cut into four pieces for him who understands the evil done to him as good one.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਤਿਸ ਦੈ ਚਉ ਖੰਨੀਐ ਮੰਦਾ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: hau tis dhai chau kha(n)neeaai ma(n)dhaa kisai na aakh vakhaanai|

en.bdb: I am ready to be cut into four pieces for him who never speaks ill of anyone.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਤਿਸ ਦੈ ਚਉ ਖੰਨੀਐ ਆਪੁ ਠਗਾਏ ਲੋਕਾ ਭਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: hau tis dhai chau kha(n)neeaai aap Thagaae lokaa bhaanai|

en.bdb: I am ready to be cut into four pieces for him who is ready to suffer loss for the sake of others.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਤਿਸ ਦੈ ਚਉ ਖੰਨੀਐ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰ ਕਰੈ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: hau tis dhai chau kha(n)neeaai paraupakaar karai ra(n)g maanai|

en.bdb: I am ready to be cut into four pieces for him who enjoys doing altruistic activities.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਉਬਾਲੀ ਦਰਗਾਹ ਵਿਚਿ ਮਾਣੁ ਨਿਮਾਣਾ ਮਾਣੁ ਨਿਮਾਣੈ।
verses.translit_en: laubaalee dharagaeh vich maan nimaanaa maan nimaanai|

en.bdb: I am ready to be cut into four pieces for him who enjoys doing altruistic activities.
Such a humble person understanding the Word of Guru, himself becomes the perfect Guru.
